# sprint four-dx leads update

Package: `@hyungjuk/sprint` · Version: `1.1.0`

[CLI index](../../../README.md) · [Parent](../leads.md)

## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint four-dx leads update — update authorized 4DX leads; server validates permissions and revisions

SYNOPSIS
  sprint four-dx leads update ID --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH --expected-revision REVISION [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  update authorized 4DX leads; server validates permissions and revisions

EXAMPLES
  sprint four-dx leads update ID --file input.json --expected-revision REVISION

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  ID

FLAGS
  --expected-revision REVISION (required; see SYNOPSIS)
  --json-data OBJECT | --file PATH

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

OUTPUT
  output {data} on stdout; errors on stderr.

AUTHENTICATION
  Sprint profile or automation-token file required. Server permissions are authoritative.

NOTES
  Examples use placeholder IDs and files; replace them with authorized current values.
  4DX lists GET /api/four-dx and select the named array; scoreboard GETs /api/four-dx/scoreboard without local aggregation. Filters: --quarter YYYY-Q1..Q4; --scope-type personal|team and --scope-id ID together; scoreboard --week-start YYYY-MM-DD and --as-of YYYY-MM-DD business date in server WORK_TIME_ZONE. Lists accept --include-deleted. Server validates Monday, scope, period and domain fields. Create/update/correct/void require exactly one --json-data OBJECT or --file PATH. Update uses PATCH; delete is restorable; restore uses POST. Server requires current --expected-revision REVISION (If-Match) for update/delete/restore/correct/void and create with supersedes; missing revision returns HTTP 428 (exit 7), stale revision HTTP 409 (exit 9). Optional --operation-key KEY is supported for create/correct only. Correct ID appends supersedes=ID with the complete replacement payload; void ID requires {reason:string}. Observation/report update/delete/restore are unsupported. Target/baseline updates require reason and preserve definition history; recorded measurement/recording/unit/quarter changes remain server-restricted. No automatic retries, client aggregation or implicit metric changes from commitment reports.
  JSON payload: {"name":"string","unit":"string","measurement":"number | ratio","recording":"snapshot | daily | period","baseline":"finite number","target":"finite number different from baseline","goalId":"existing goal ID","behavior":"string","ownerMemberId?":"member ID authorized for linked goal scope"}

SEE ALSO

  Documentation: https://github.com/Hyungjuk42/sprint-docs/blob/main/cli/reference/four-dx/leads/update.md
```
